summary: Diagnosed and fixed a bug where leaving a thread mid-stream caused the in-flight assistant message to be lost on return. Added an `activeAssistantMessageId` getter on `PiEventTranslator`, an `inFlightAssistantView` helper in `session-transcript.ts`, and updated `pi-agent-service.resumeSession` so the active branch splices the live in-flight view into the snapshot when one exists, alongside a loosened `PiSessionLike.messages` content typing for `BashExecutionMessage`.
decisions: Reuse the existing JSONL file as the snapshot source for active sessions rather than rebuilding from the live manager — `snapshot()` already reads the file, so keep that and only splice the in-flight view on top.

Represent the in-flight view via `inFlightAssistantView(activeAssistantId, partial)` using the translator's id so subsequent `message.update` events continue to update the same message rather than appending a new one.
Guard the splice with `if (inFlight)` and rely on the translator clearing `#activeMessageIds` at `message_end` so the completed message is not duplicated when `agent_settled` lags the persistence.
Make `PiSessionLike.messages[].content` optional because pi's `AgentMessage` union includes `BashExecutionMessage` without a `content` field.
errors: TypeScript check failed: `PiSessionLike.messages[].content` was typed as required but `BashExecutionMessage` lacks `content`. Fixed by making `content` optional on the interface.
